notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control a basic Plains.
description:
Cast Legion Conquistador by paying {2}{W}.
When Legion Conquistador enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping Legion Conquistador, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Legion Conquistador and putting it on the bottom of your library, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Legion Conquistador's trigger, searching your library for a card named Legion Conquistador and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.
